select a.days termType,nvl(a.amt,0) sessionendBalance from( select days,sum(ENDAMTSUM_OTH) amt from( select case when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE=1 then '01' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>1 and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE<=92 then '02' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>92 and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE<=184 then '03' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>184 and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE<=366 then '04' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>366 and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE<=1096 then '05' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>1096 and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE<=1826 then '06' when fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>1826 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH from CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION cp left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=CP.PRODID where fp.OPERATION_TYPE='01' and CP.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and fp.MDATE-CP.ENDDATE>0) group by days)a

with plannum as(select finprod_id,count(1) plancounts from FIN_OPEN_PLAN group by finprod_id), planv as (select finprod_id,min(OPEN_DATE_STR) minopenstart from FIN_OPEN_PLAN where OPEN_DATE_STR>#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} group by finprod_id) ,enddays as( select CASE WHEN nvl(plannum.plancounts,0) = 0 THEN 1 /*开放计划条数为0，表示高频开放*/ ELSE greatest(nvl(planv.minopenstart,ffp.mdate)- #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0) END days ,FINPROD_MARKET_ID from FIN_PRODUCT ffp left join plannum on plannum.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id left join planv on planv.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id where OPERATION_TYPE='02' and ffp.P_FINPROD_ID is null ) select a.days termType,nvl(a.amt,0) sessionendBalance from( select days,sum(ENDAMTSUM_OTH) amt from( select case when enddays.days<=1 then '01' when enddays.days>1 and enddays.days<=92 then '02' when enddays.days>92 and enddays.days<=184 then '03' when enddays.days>184 and enddays.days<=366 then '04' when enddays.days>366 and enddays.days<=1096 then '05' when enddays.days>1096 and enddays.days<=1826 then '06' when enddays.days>1826 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH from CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION cp inner join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=CP.PRODID where CP.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) group by days)a order by a.days

with rate as( SELECT RUL.FINPROD_ID,rul.yield FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE rul left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT info on info.FINPROD_ID=rul.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON rul.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE info.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F16','F24') AND info.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' and B.CASH_TYPE_1 = '02' AND rul.BRANCH=0 and rul.eff_date=(select max(eff_date) from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fc1 where fc1.FINPROD_ID= RUL.FINPROD_ID and fc1.eff_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) ,pos as( select bpp.cdate,bpp.FINPROD_ID,bpp.TDY_SHARE_AMT from BOK_POSITION_PRD bpp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on BPP.FINPROD_ID=FPA.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=bpp.FINPROD_ID left join rate on rate.FINPROD_ID=bpp.FINPROD_ID where fpa.PROFIT_FLAG='03' and PROFIT_TYPE = '02' and rate.FINPROD_ID is not null and BPP.CDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} ), plannum as(select finprod_id,count(1) plancounts from FIN_OPEN_PLAN group by finprod_id) , planv as (select finprod_id,min(OPEN_DATE_STR) minopenstart from FIN_OPEN_PLAN where OPEN_DATE_STR>#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} group by finprod_id)
,enddays as( select case when ffp.OPERATION_TYPE='01'/*01封闭式，02开放式*/ then greatest(ffp.mdate-#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE},0) else CASE WHEN nvl(plannum.plancounts,0) = 0 THEN 1 /*开放计划条数为0，表示高频开放*/ ELSE greatest(nvl(planv.minopenstart,ffp.mdate)- #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0) END end days ,ffp.finprod_id from FIN_PRODUCT ffp left join plannum on plannum.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id left join planv on planv.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id
) ,psi as( select case when enddays.days<=1 then '01' when enddays.days>1 and enddays.days<=92 then '02' when enddays.days>92 and enddays.days<=184 then '03' when enddays.days>184 and enddays.days<=366 then '04' when enddays.days>366 and enddays.days<=1096 then '05' when enddays.days>1096 and enddays.days<=1826 then '06' when enddays.days>1826 then '07' end days,pos.TDY_SHARE_AMT* nvl(rate.YIELD,0) amt from pos left join rate on RATE.FINPROD_ID=POS.FINPROD_ID left join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_ID=pos.FINPROD_ID ) ,psiav as( SELECT days,sum(nvl(amt,0)) amt from psi group by days) ,psit as( select case when enddays.days<=1 then '01' when enddays.days>1 and enddays.days<=92 then '02' when enddays.days>92 and enddays.days<=184 then '03' when enddays.days>184 and enddays.days<=366 then '04' when enddays.days>366 and enddays.days<=1096 then '05' when enddays.days>1096 and enddays.days<=1826 then '06' when enddays.days>1826 then '07' end days,pos.TDY_SHARE_AMT amtp from pos left join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_ID=pos.FINPROD_ID ) ,psiavt as( SELECT days,sum(nvl(amtp,0)) amt from psit group by days)
select psiav.days termType,psiavt.amt shareamt,psiav.amt syamt,psiav.amt/psiavt.amt sessionendYield from psiav left join psiavt on psiav.days=psiavt.days where psiavt.amt !=0 union all select psiav.days termType,psiavt.amt shareamt,psiav.amt syamt,0 sessionendYield from psiav left join psiavt on psiav.days=psiavt.days where psiavt.amt =0

with pic as( SELECT INT_RATE_ID, int_rate_type, int_rate FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.INT_RATE_ID, brating.int_rate_type order by EFF_DATE DESC ) my_rank , brating.INT_RATE_ID , brating.int_rate_type, brating.int_rate FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO brating where EFF_DATE<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) WHERE my_rank=1 ), rate as( select fbr.FINPROD_ID, case when rate_type='01' then fbr.rate else nvl(fbr.coefficient,0)*nvl(pic.int_rate,0)+nvl(fbr.spread_rate,0) end yield from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO fbr left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fbr.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID left join pic on fbr.index_id=PIC.INT_RATE_ID and fbr.index_source=PIC.INT_RATE_TYPE where FP.PROFIT_TYPE !='02' and fbr.BASE_RULE_TYPE='02' and fbr.eff_date =(select max(fb.eff_date) from FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO fb where fb.FINPROD_ID=fbr.FINPROD_ID and fb.BASE_RULE_TYPE='02' and fb.eff_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) ) ,pos as( select bpp.cdate,bpp.FINPROD_ID,bpp.TDY_SHARE_AMT from BOK_POSITION_PRD bpp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on BPP.FINPROD_ID=FPA.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=bpp.FINPROD_ID left join rate on rate.FINPROD_ID=bpp.FINPROD_ID where fpa.PROFIT_FLAG='03' and PROFIT_TYPE != '02' and rate.FINPROD_ID is not null and BPP.CDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} ) ,plannum as(select finprod_id,count(1) plancounts from FIN_OPEN_PLAN group by finprod_id) , planv as (select finprod_id,min(OPEN_DATE_STR) minopenstart from FIN_OPEN_PLAN where OPEN_DATE_STR>#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} group by finprod_id)
,enddays as( select case when ffp.OPERATION_TYPE='01'/*01封闭式，02开放式*/ then greatest(ffp.mdate-#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE},0) else CASE WHEN nvl(plannum.plancounts,0) = 0 THEN 1 /*开放计划条数为0，表示高频开放*/ ELSE greatest(nvl(planv.minopenstart,ffp.mdate)- #{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}, 0) END end days ,ffp.finprod_id from FIN_PRODUCT ffp left join plannum on plannum.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id left join planv on planv.finprod_id=ffp.finprod_id
) ,psi as( select case when enddays.days<=1 then '01' when enddays.days>1 and enddays.days<=92 then '02' when enddays.days>92 and enddays.days<=184 then '03' when enddays.days>184 and enddays.days<=366 then '04' when enddays.days>366 and enddays.days<=1096 then '05' when enddays.days>1096 and enddays.days<=1826 then '06' when enddays.days>1826 then '07' end days,pos.TDY_SHARE_AMT* nvl(RATE.YIELD,0) amt from pos left join rate on RATE.FINPROD_ID=POS.FINPROD_ID left join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_ID=pos.FINPROD_ID ) ,psiav as( SELECT days,sum(nvl(amt,0)) amt from psi group by days) ,psit as( select case when enddays.days<=1 then '01' when enddays.days>1 and enddays.days<=92 then '02' when enddays.days>92 and enddays.days<=184 then '03' when enddays.days>184 and enddays.days<=366 then '04' when enddays.days>366 and enddays.days<=1096 then '05' when enddays.days>1096 and enddays.days<=1826 then '06' when enddays.days>1826 then '07' end days,pos.TDY_SHARE_AMT amtp from pos left join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_ID=pos.FINPROD_ID ) ,psiavt as( SELECT days,sum(nvl(amtp,0)) amt from psit group by days)
select psiav.days termType,psiavt.amt shareamt,psiav.amt syamt,psiav.amt/psiavt.amt sessionendYield from psiav left join psiavt on psiav.days=psiavt.days where psiavt.amt !=0 union all select psiav.days termType,psiavt.amt shareamt,psiav.amt syamt,0 sessionendYield from psiav left join psiavt on psiav.days=psiavt.days where psiavt.amt =0

ORDER by A.DAYS

select A.DAYS termType,A.AMT sessionendBalance from( select t.days,sum(t.amt) amt from( select nvl(CAP.ASSETVALUE_A,0) amt, case when BAD.END_DAYS is null then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS <=1 then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS>1 and BAD.END_DAYS<=92 then '02' when BAD.END_DAYS>92 and BAD.END_DAYS<=184 then '03' when BAD.END_DAYS>184 and BAD.END_DAYS<=366 then '04' when BAD.END_DAYS>366 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1096 then '05' when BAD.END_DAYS>1096 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1826 then '06' when BAD.END_DAYS>1826 then '07' end days from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cap left join ( select DISTINCT FINPROD_MARKET_ID,END_DAYS from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA where cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}) bad on CAP.ASSET_CODE=BAD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=CAP.ASSET_CODE left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID where CAP.ASSET_CODE !='REMAININGCASH' and CAP.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and CAP.ASSETTYPE IN ('04','05','14') and CAP.ASSETTYPE2 not in ('2101','1399','1599','2299','1901','1902') and fpt.TYPE_11 not in ('057','075','076') ) t GROUP by t.DAYS ) a ORDER by A.DAYS

SELECT CAP.ASSETTYPE2 termType, SUM(cap.ASSETVALUE_A) sessionendBalance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cap WHERE CAP.ENDDATE =#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND CAP.ASSETTYPE2 ='1901' group by CAP.ASSETTYPE2 UNION ALL SELECT CAP.ASSETTYPE2 termType, SUM(cap.ASSETVALUE_A) sessionendBalance FROM CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION cap WHERE CAP.ENDDATE =#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND CAP.ASSETTYPE2 ='1902' group by CAP.ASSETTYPE2

with cj as( select cap.ASSETTYPE2, sum(SHARE_AMT*YIELD) amt from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD left join (select DISTINCT ASSETTYPE2,asset_code from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION where ENDDATE =#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND ASSETTYPE2 in ('1901','1902') ) cap on BAD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=cap.asset_code where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and cap.asset_code is not null group by cap.ASSETTYPE2 ), bj as( select cap.ASSETTYPE2,sum(SHARE_AMT) amt from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD left join (select DISTINCT ASSETTYPE2,asset_code from CHB_MONTH_ASSET_POSITION where ENDDATE =#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} AND ASSETTYPE2 in ('1901','1902') ) cap on BAD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=cap.asset_code where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and cap.asset_code is not null group by cap.ASSETTYPE2 ) select bj.ASSETTYPE2 termType,cj.amt/bj.amt sessionendYield from bj left join cj on bj.ASSETTYPE2= cj.ASSETTYPE2 where bj.amt !=0 union all select bj.ASSETTYPE2 termType,0 sessionendYield from bj left join cj on bj.ASSETTYPE2= cj.ASSETTYPE2 where bj.amt =0

with cj as( select SHARE_AMT*YIELD amt, case when BAD.END_DAYS is null then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS <=1 then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS>1 and BAD.END_DAYS<=92 then '02' when BAD.END_DAYS>92 and BAD.END_DAYS<=184 then '03' when BAD.END_DAYS>184 and BAD.END_DAYS<=366 then '04' when BAD.END_DAYS>366 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1096 then '05' when BAD.END_DAYS>1096 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1826 then '06' when BAD.END_DAYS>1826 then '07' end days from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and BAD.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F04','F08') ), bj as( select SHARE_AMT amt, case when BAD.END_DAYS is null then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS <=1 then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS>1 and BAD.END_DAYS<=92 then '02' when BAD.END_DAYS>92 and BAD.END_DAYS<=184 then '03' when BAD.END_DAYS>184 and BAD.END_DAYS<=366 then '04' when BAD.END_DAYS>366 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1096 then '05' when BAD.END_DAYS>1096 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1826 then '06' when BAD.END_DAYS>1826 then '07' end days from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and BAD.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F04','F08') ), scj as( select days,sum(amt) amt from cj GROUP by days), sbj as( select days,sum(amt) amt from bj GROUP by days)
select scj.days termType,scj.amt/sbj.amt sessionendYield from scj left join sbj on scj.days=sbj.days where sbj.amt !=0 union all select scj.days termType,0 sessionendYield from scj left join sbj on scj.days=sbj.days where sbj.amt =0

with cj as( select SHARE_AMT*YIELD amt, case when BAD.END_DAYS is null then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS <=1 then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS>1 and BAD.END_DAYS<=92 then '02' when BAD.END_DAYS>92 and BAD.END_DAYS<=184 then '03' when BAD.END_DAYS>184 and BAD.END_DAYS<=366 then '04' when BAD.END_DAYS>366 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1096 then '05' when BAD.END_DAYS>1096 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1826 then '06' when BAD.END_DAYS>1826 then '07' end days from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=BAD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and fpt.TYPE_11 not in ('057','075','076') and BAD.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F04','F08') ), bj as( select SHARE_AMT amt, case when BAD.END_DAYS is null then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS <=1 then '01' when BAD.END_DAYS>1 and BAD.END_DAYS<=92 then '02' when BAD.END_DAYS>92 and BAD.END_DAYS<=184 then '03' when BAD.END_DAYS>184 and BAD.END_DAYS<=366 then '04' when BAD.END_DAYS>366 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1096 then '05' when BAD.END_DAYS>1096 and BAD.END_DAYS<=1826 then '06' when BAD.END_DAYS>1826 then '07' end days from BUSI_REPORT_BASIS_ASSET_DATA BAD left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID=BAD.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID where BAD.cdate=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and fpt.TYPE_11 not in ('057','075','076') and BAD.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F02','F04','F08') ), scj as( select days,sum(amt) amt from cj GROUP by days), sbj as( select days,sum(amt) amt from bj GROUP by days) select scj.days termType,scj.amt/sbj.amt sessionendYield from scj left join sbj on scj.days=sbj.days where sbj.amt !=0 union all select scj.days termType,0 sessionendYield from scj left join sbj on scj.days=sbj.days where sbj.amt =0

select a.days termType,nvl(a.amt,0) sessionendBalance from( select days,sum(ENDAMTSUM_OTH) amt from( select case when cp.termtype='01' then '01' when cp.termtype in ('02','03','04') then '02' when cp.termtype ='05' then '03' when cp.termtype ='06' then '04' when cp.termtype ='07' then '05' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH from CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION cp where cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and cp.termtype in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07')
union all select case when base.mdate-base.vdate>1096 and base.mdate-base.vdate<=1827 then '06' when base.mdate-base.vdate>1827 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH from chb_month_prd_position cp left join chb_prd_baseinfo base on cp.prodid=base.prod_id where 1=1 and cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and base.operate_mode in ('01','02') and base.mdate-base.vdate>1096
union all select case when base.opendayp>1096 and base.opendayp<=1827 then '06' when base.opendayp>1827 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH from chb_month_prd_position cp left join chb_prd_baseinfo base on cp.prodid=base.prod_id where 1=1 and cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and base.operate_mode in ('03','04') and base.opendayp>1096 ) group by days )a order by a.days

with rate as(
select distinct cr.prod_id as prodid,nvl(cr.prod_yield,cr.prod_benchmark_rate) as prodRate from chb_prd_rate cr where 1=1 and cr.change_type in ('01','03') and cr.change_date=(select max(change_date) from chb_prd_rate fc1 where fc1.prod_id= cr.prod_id and fc1.change_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE})
select distinct cr.prod_id as prodid, decode (cr.profit_type,'02',cr.prod_yield,'03',cr.seven_day_rate,'01', case when base.mdate-base.vdate<=365 and crmin.unit_value is not null and crmin.unit_value !=0 then (crmax.unit_value-crmin.unit_value)/crmin.unit_value/(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}-crmin.change_date+1)*365 when base.mdate-base.vdate<=365 and crmin.unit_value is null then 0 when base.mdate-base.vdate>365 and crlastmax.unit_value_total!=null and crmin.unit_value_total !=0 then (crmax.unit_value_total-crlastmax.unit_value_total)/crlastmax.unit_value_total when base.mdate-base.vdate>365 and crlastmax.unit_value_total is null and crmin.unit_value is not null and crmin.unit_value !=0 then (crmax.unit_value-crmin.unit_value)/crmin.unit_value/(#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}-crmin.change_date+1)*365 when base.mdate-base.vdate>365 and crlastmax.unit_value_total is null and crmin.unit_value is null then 0 end ) as prodRate from chb_prd_rate cr left join chb_prd_baseinfo base on cr.prod_id=base.prod_id
left join (select cr1.prod_id,cr1.unit_value,cr1.unit_value_total ,cr1.change_date from chb_prd_rate cr1 where cr1.change_date=(select max(change_date) from chb_prd_rate fc1 where fc1.prod_id= cr1.prod_id and fc1.change_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}))crmax on cr.prod_id=crmax.prod_id
left join (select cr1.prod_id,cr1.unit_value,cr1.unit_value_total ,cr1.change_date from chb_prd_rate cr1 where cr1.change_date=(select min(change_date) from chb_prd_rate fc1 where fc1.prod_id= cr1.prod_id and fc1.change_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE}))crmin on cr.prod_id=crmin.prod_id
left join (select cr1.prod_id,cr1.unit_value,cr1.unit_value_total,cr1.change_date from chb_prd_rate cr1 where cr1.change_date=(select max(change_date) from chb_prd_rate fc1 where fc1.prod_id= cr1.prod_id and fc1.change_date<#{lastYearDate,jdbcType=DATE}))crlastmax on cr.prod_id=crlastmax.prod_id
where 1=1 and cr.change_type in ('01','02') and cr.change_date=(select max(change_date) from chb_prd_rate fc1 where fc1.prod_id= cr.prod_id and fc1.change_date<=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE})
) ,enddays as( select case when cp.termtype='01' then '01' when cp.termtype in ('02','03','04') then '02' when cp.termtype ='05' then '03' when cp.termtype ='06' then '04' when cp.termtype ='07' then '05' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH as amt,cp.prodid from CHB_MONTH_PRD_POSITION cp where cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and cp.termtype in ('01','02','03','04','05','06','07')
union all select case when base.mdate-base.vdate>1096 and base.mdate-base.vdate<=1827 then '06' when base.mdate-base.vdate>1827 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH as amt,cp.prodid from chb_month_prd_position cp left join chb_prd_baseinfo base on cp.prodid=base.prod_id where 1=1 and cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and base.operate_mode in ('01','02') and base.mdate-base.vdate>1096
union all select case when base.opendayp>1096 and base.opendayp<=1827 then '06' when base.opendayp>1827 then '07' end days, cp.ENDAMTSUM_OTH as amt,cp.prodid from chb_month_prd_position cp left join chb_prd_baseinfo base on cp.prodid=base.prod_id where 1=1 and cp.ENDDATE=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE} and base.operate_mode in ('03','04') and base.opendayp>1096
) ,possum as( select end.days as days,sum(nvl(end.amt,0)) as sumamt from enddays end group by end.days ) ,psisum as( select end.days as days,sum(nvl(end.amt,0)* nvl(rate.prodRate,0)) sumAllamt from enddays end left join rate on end.prodid=rate.prodid group by end.days )
select psisum.days termType,psisum.sumAllamt/possum.sumamt sessionendYield from psisum left join possum on psisum.days=possum.days where possum.sumamt !=0
